run_rtmdet_x_p6_training: run the RTMDet-X P6 model training on COCO with 300 epochs and batch size 8
configure_rtmdet_backbone_p6: configure the RTMDet backbone to use P6 architecture with output indices 2 through 5
customize_train_pipeline_augmentation: customize the training pipeline with CachedMosaic, RandomResize, RandomCrop, and YOLOXHSVRandomAug augmentations
setup_test_time_augmentation: setup test-time augmentation with multi-scale resizing at 640, 1280, and 1920 pixel resolutions
configure_learning_rate_schedule: configure a LinearLR warmup followed by CosineAnnealingLR scheduler for 300 epoch training
